prompt: Most people now receive their news through social media rather than through newspapers or broadcasters. Some believe this has made public debate more open, while others think it has left people less well informed. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
essay:
In the modern world, most of the people get their news from the social media instead of the newspaper or the television. Some people think this is a good development because everybody can share the information, but other people think that it makes the society less informed. In this essay I will discuss the both views.

On the one hand, the supporters of the social media say that it is more open. In the past, only the big companies could decide which news is important, but now every person can post about the events in his city. For example, when there is a protest or a disaster, the ordinary people can share the photos and the videos immediately, and the whole world can see it. Also the social media is free, so the poor people can also get the information without paying the money.

On the other hand, many people believe that the social media give us the wrong information. There is a lot of fake news on the internet and it spreads very fast. Moreover, the algorithm shows us only the news which we like, so we never see the different opinion. Because of this, the people become more extreme in their thinking and the society become divided.

In conclusion, both of the views have the strong points. The social media is more open than the traditional media, but at the same time it can give the wrong information to the people. In my opinion, the governments should make the rules for the social media companies to solve this problem.
title: Getting the news from social media
